sentences.text: This marine reptile belongs to the family Mosasauridae and the subfamily Plioplatecarpinae, placing it within the tribe Plioplatecarpini.
Originally named Clidastes planifrons by Cope in 1874, the genus was later reclassified as Plesioplatecarpus by Takuya Konishi and Michael W. Caldwell in 2011.
The type specimen, which serves as the basis for the species description, is the nearly complete skeleton AMNH 1491.
Scientists created this new genus because phylogenetic analysis revealed that Platecarpus planifrons was distinct from the genus Platecarpus.
It lived during the Late Cretaceous, from the middle Coniacian to the middle Santonian stages, in the northern Gulf of Mexico and the Western Interior Basin of North America.
